title: JustEnoughItems issue #4532: [Crash]: Viewing mob drops tab crashes game.

text:
[issue by UncleSpoods]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

1.) Open desired world

2.) Navigate to a mob drop's information via JEI

3.) Select the Mob Drops tab, the game will crashes after a few seconds.

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

https://modrinth.com/modpack/bogwood-matcha-flavoured

### Mod Pack Version (Optional)

1.3.2

### Extra Notes (Optional)

The modpack is largely the same out of the box, I did however remove a resource pack or two, and added a couple mods, such as Macaw's mods.

I also have found a prior resolved report mentioning the exact same issue, however I decided to post this considering the prior reports were in versions 1.20 and 1.21, where as this is in 26.2.

### Crash Report

https://gist.github.com/UncleSpoods/4414abcb6ff04001c1f3ceaa0406e884

[comment by mezz (owner)]
Thanks for the report!
This crash is from JER (Just Enough Resources) and has been reported here: https://github.com/way2muchnoise/JustEnoughResources/issues/590
